title: The last envelopes
logline: The office counter with forty pay envelopes in a row, the names on them drawn as gray strokes, one hand taking one. The last payday. Whose hand: the second row's, the page suggests, and doesn't say.

panels.composition: A mill office counter with forty small pay envelopes in a row, names on them drawn as gray strokes, a broad man's hand taking one from the row.
